$comment: H2→H3 contract (OVERVIEW §5.6). Maps each browser-use custom action to the stable selector it clicks, the gate it belongs to, the funnel stage it reaches, and the observable DOM change that confirms success. Identical on shopee-stub.html and the real /shopee/matinkim-beanie page. Never rename a hook without pinging H3.

entry.note: The browser-use driver navigates to {base}/?listing=<slug>; the SPA redirects to the product page. The land/photos/reviews/price/cart hooks all live on that product page. checkout becomes reachable there (sticky bar) once an item is in the cart, and also on /cart; confirm-order lives on /checkout.

events.note: Both fire on every action click. H3 may listen to either to confirm + time a step; they are advisory — the authoritative success signal is the observable DOM change.

actions.observable: active gallery photo advances: [data-field="gallery-index"] increments and the selected thumb ([aria-selected="true"]) moves.
reviews body expands ([data-reviews-body] loses [hidden]); button [aria-expanded] flips to true; seller response rate visible.
clicked variant gets [aria-pressed="true"]; [data-field="selected-variant"] updates; price ([data-field="price"]) is visible.

real app: present on the product page sticky bar (after add-to-cart) AND on /cart; clicking navigates to /checkout (URL changes, [data-gate="checkout"] + [data-action="confirm-order"] present on the new page). stub: scrolls to the checkout section.
real app: navigates to /order-confirmed (order number visible). stub: [data-order-status] becomes visible.
